headline: OJK Reveals 3 Suspects in Stock Manipulation, Alleged Losses Rp6,97 M
summary: Indonesia's financial services authority OJK has detained three suspects in trading manipulation on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. The alleged losses total Rp6.97 billion.
why: The OJK regulates Indonesia's capital markets, and enforcement against manipulation supports investor confidence in exchange trading.
original_headline: OJK Ungkap 3 Tersangka Manipulasi Saham, Dugaan Kerugian Rp6,97 M
